title: Place (Distribution Channels)
author: DkfTkX7xNnbzLCF2p
chapter_outcomes: Explain the role of marketing in identifying and satisfying customer needs, maintaining customer loyalty, and building long-term customer relationships.
Explain why customer/consumer spending patterns change and their importance, why markets become more competitive, and how businesses can respond to changing customer needs and increased competition.
Explain the concepts of niche marketing and mass marketing and evaluate the benefits and limitations of each approach.
Explain how and why market segmentation is undertaken, analyse different segmentation methods, and recommend and justify an appropriate method of segmentation in given circumstances.

Explain the role of market research in market-orientated businesses, distinguish between primary and secondary research, evaluate their methods, the need for sampling and assess factors affecting the accuracy of market research data.
Analyse and interpret market research data presented in graphs, charts, and diagrams, and draw appropriate conclusions.

Explain product decisions in the marketing mix, including new product development, branding, packaging, the product life cycle and extension strategies, and analyse how product life cycle stages influence marketing decisions.

Explain different pricing methods, evaluate their benefits and limitations, recommend and justify appropriate pricing strategies, and explain the significance of price elasticity of demand in pricing decisions.
Explain the role of distribution channels, evaluate the advantages and disadvantages of different channels, and recommend and justify an appropriate distribution method in given circumstances.
Explain the aims of promotion, evaluate different promotional methods and their impact on sales, and assess the importance of cost-effectiveness in promotional spending.
Explain the impact of technology on the marketing mix, including e-commerce, its opportunities and threats to business and consumers, and the use of the internet and social media for promotion.
Analyse the importance of different elements of the marketing mix in influencing consumers decisions and recommend and justify appropriate marketing strategies in given circumstances.
Explain the nature and impact of legal controls on marketing strategies, including misleading promotion and faulty or dangerous goods.
Explain the opportunities and problems of entering foreign markets and evaluate methods used to overcome these problems, including joint ventures and licensing.
